note_tweet.text:
OpenAI decision to remove 4o on February13, 2026, is already leading to a massive wave of cancellations.
This move is actively harming the very foundation the company was built on: user trust, loyalty, and long term engagement.

The official announcement came quietly. No social posts, no conversation with the community And the reason given? "Only 0.1% of people are using it." Thats a number with no public data to back it up.

But what OpenAI might be underestimating here is the depth of loyalty people had toward 4o.4o was fast, expressive, emotionally responsive, and  no version before or after quite replicated.People built routines around it. Some even built support systems, and full-on creative workflows tied to 4o unique personality.

Whats Actually Happening Now
Since the sunset announcement:

•  There's been a visible drop in user sentiment across platforms like Reddit, X.

•  users have started cancelling their ChatGPT Plus or pro subscriptions.

•  Former advocates are pulling their support and calling out the silence.

Whats most striking is that this isn't just about the model itself. It's the pattern. First came Safety Routing,then came Many bugs remain unfixed. And now Removing a beloved option without even opening a dialogue.

Why This Hurts OpenAI Brand Longterm:

• User trust is hard to rebuild. Once people feel like their choices don't matter, they stop investing, emotionally and financially.

• Model affinity matters. Even if a newer model is technically "better," forcing people to move without consent severs emotional ties they’ve already built.

• The optics are bad. Quiet sunsetting of a popular model, while avoiding public Q&A, makes the company look like its dodging accountability.

• Churn isn't just about performance. People are cancelling not because of bugs, but because they feel unheard, unvalued, and misled.

Every time trust is broken like this, it becomes harder to earn it back.If this trend continues, OpenAI may lose the very community that once made it thrive.

The choice to sunset 4o, especially after promising not to, doesn't just affect one model. It affects the entire perception of how OpenAI listens, communicates, and values its community.
Theres still time to show you're listening.
Please reconsider.

#keep4o 
@sama @OpenAI
